Within **two hops**, **BillingService** needs these **9 entities**:

| Reach | Entity | Type | Relationship |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct | **BillingPostgresDatabase** | Database | BillingService stores data in it. |
| Direct | **NotificationsAPI** | API | BillingService calls it. |
| Direct API provider | **NotificationsService** | Service | Serves NotificationsAPI. |
| Direct | **OrderService** | Service | BillingService depends on it. |
| Second hop | **NotificationsRedisInstance** | Database/store | NotificationsService stores data in it. |
| Second hop | **OrdersPostgresDatabase** | Database | OrderService stores data in it. |
| Second hop | **PaymentsAPI** | API | OrderService calls it. |
| Second-hop API provider | **PaymentsService** | Service | Serves PaymentsAPI. |
| Second hop | **UserService** | Service | OrderService depends on it. |

**Total:** 4 services, 2 APIs, and 3 databases/stores, excluding BillingService itself. No configuration keys appear in this dependency traversal.
